svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: One environment on AWS
svg.desc: One environment on AWS. 14 components in 10 groups. Connections: Users to Internet gateway (HTTP :80, :8080); Internet gateway to Application Load Balancer; Application Load Balancer to Blue target group (:80 prod); Application Load Balancer to Green target group (:8080 test, 30% of :80); Blue target group to Auto Scaling group and ECS capacity provider; Green target group to Auto Scaling group and ECS capacity provider; Amazon Elastic Container Service to NAT gateway; Amazon Elastic Container Service to NAT gateway; Auto Scaling group and ECS capacity provider to AWS X-Ray (traces); Auto Scaling group and ECS capacity provider to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (image pull); Application Load Balancer to CloudWatch alarms (metrics); CloudWatch alarms to SNS alarm topic; Amazon Elastic Container Registry to AWS Key Management Service; SNS alarm topic to AWS Key Management Service.

text.tspan: dev, test and prod each get this stack (own ALB, ECS cluster and Auto Scaling group) in the shared VPC
AUTO SCALING GROUP AND ECS CAPACITY PROVIDER
ENCRYPTED WITH THE PROJECT KMS KEY
